body.statement: The empirical profiled inversion satisfies \[\liminf_{N\to\infty}\inf_{P\in\mathcal M_N:\mu_D(P)>0}P\{\theta_T(P)\in C_N^{\mathrm{AR}}\}\ge1-\alpha.\] This holds uniformly across changes and ties in the minimizing allocation without consistent estimation of a selected oracle optimizer.
body.justification: The result supplies implementable coverage through weak compliance and collection-only overlap.
body.gap: Ma's Theorem 3.2 controls one orthogonal LATE score, not a null-indexed estimated collection value and its allocation-face transitions.
body.consumer: Multi-site analysts can avoid compliance pretests and oracle source weights.
